title: City: City Foundation - Bota Na Nos
description: With support of Citi Foundation, Bota na Mesa aims to mobilize the food chain in large urban centers by promoting the creation of a network that favors the inclusion of small producers and family agriculture organizations, fair trade, environmental preservation and food safety.  View other Citi videos: http://www.youtube.com/citi Read our Blog: http://blog.citigroup.com Like us on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/citi Follow us on Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/citi Follow us on LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/company/citi Follow us on Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/citi Follow us on Google+: http://www.google.com/+citi

asr.full_text: COUNTY FOR A NEW DEVICE AND THE VICE PRODUCER HOWEVER YOU WANT TO GO DO NOT RETURN My name is Nelson de Moura Montarroz, family farmer, and I grow vegetables. I started producing about 22 years ago, as a farmer before and now I am a family farmer. I had a meeting with City Street on Paulista Avenue, we also did group meetings passing the producer´s information to others. Many topics were discussed that were not even in the plot. So how to get to the client, how to discuss, inform, what kind of trade I am learning in meetings. How to discuss, how to inform, types of merchandise, everything I learn, there at the meetings. I bring information to my partners, we have meetings that happen at least once a month, and everything I learn I pass it on to them, that helps me and also helps them. A lot of things came into our lives. All the changes that were needed by Maxaca, that we didn't have to implement at first. It improved everything we were talking about. We have some chance to improve and improve the situation. This really will change. It became easy to have a market for business sales. Well, they'll be make our name known, thus believing that it will be better.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it profiles Bota na Mesa, a Citi Foundation-supported program focused on food-chain networks for small producers, and includes a speaker identifying himself as a family farmer. The content centers on farming, producer meetings, and practical information for partners. The program text and learn-more URL appear to provide informational outreach for the agricultural project rather than a deceptive participation flow.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is agricultural knowledge-sharing and practical operational support for family farmers, including meetings, information exchange, trade and access to markets.
